title: Arrival & Registration
whatToDo: Go to the International Department or registration desk. Show your passport and insurance card only if requested.
whereToGo: Main entrance → Ask for International Department or Registration Desk → Follow posted hospital signs
whatToSay: Hello, I need to register for a general checkup. Could you help me with the next step?
whatToSayZh: 你好，我想挂号做常规检查。请问下一步应该怎么做？
whatHappensNext: Staff may create a patient file, ask about payment or insurance, and give you a registration or queue number. Timing varies by hospital.

title: Payment & Queue
whatToDo: Pay any required registration or consultation fee at the payment counter. Keep your receipt. Then wait in the assigned area.
whereToGo: Ask staff where the payment counter and waiting area are for your department.
whatToSay: I need to pay or confirm payment for my visit. Here is my registration number.
whatToSayZh: 我需要支付或确认本次就诊费用。这是我的挂号号码。
whatHappensNext: Your queue number may appear on a screen or be called by staff. Wait times vary and may be longer than expected.

title: Doctor Consultation
whatToDo: When your number is called, go to the consultation room. Explain your symptoms clearly. The doctor will examine you and may order tests.
whereToGo: Watch the screen for your queue number and room number. Consultation rooms are along the corridor on the 2nd floor.
whatToSay: I have been feeling [describe symptoms]. It started [when]. I am concerned about [specific concern].
whatToSayZh: 我感觉[症状]。从[时间]开始的。我担心[具体问题]。
whatHappensNext: The doctor will examine you, ask questions, and decide if you need tests or prescriptions. Consultation typically takes 15-20 minutes.

title: Tests & Lab Work
whatToDo: If the doctor ordered tests, take your test forms to the lab on the 1st floor. Pay for tests at the payment counter first.
whereToGo: Go back to 1st floor → Payment counter → Then to the Lab (next to radiology department).
whatToSay: I need to do these tests. Here are my forms from the doctor.
whatToSayZh: 我需要做这些检查。这是医生开的单子。
whatHappensNext: Lab staff will collect samples (blood, urine, etc.). Results are usually ready in 1-2 hours. You can wait or come back later.

title: Get Prescription & Leave
whatToDo: Return to the doctor with your test results. The doctor will review and give you a prescription. Take it to the pharmacy.
whereToGo: Return to the same consultation room → Then go to the pharmacy on the 1st floor (near the main entrance).
whatToSay: Here are my test results. What is the next step?
whatToSayZh: 这是我的检查结果。下一步怎么办？
whatHappensNext: The doctor will explain your results and prescribe medication if needed. Pick up medicine at the pharmacy. Pay before collecting medicine.
